layout.common/<sleeve>: B3_AXC0, K04_AXC0, C1v2, C4v2 (native fill, one cell)
layout.grid_<year>: per-minute causal state + canonical P&L (observation-safe; row usable at T only if available_time <= T)
layout.ledger_<year>: per (minute, opportunity) realized canonical rows (replay input; observation-safe by available_time)
layout.decisions_<year>: canonical entry opportunities, decision-time columns only (observation-safe)
layout.outcomes_<year>: PRIVATE: fill result, realized exits, reasons, trade P&L (replay/accounting only; read_observation refuses it)
layout.signals/: decision-time source features (G3 state, LBR features, AXC0 tables, C F-leg events)

test_guard: read_partitioned/read_observation refuse *_2026 partitions without allow_test=True; the precompute itself refuses to start without --allow-test-parity
notes: G3/LBR grid minutes 2020-01-01..2026-10-07; available = source signal inputs ready
B3/K04 available 2023-09-01..2026-10-07 in two segments (native rolling-k segment ends with a data_end close at 2025-12-31 23:59; TEST restarts flat); unavailable before 2023-09-01
terminal rule (all sleeves): a position open at a ledger end is marked to the last close and charged the exit fee (G3/LBR: reserved 2 bps x w; native: 2 bps per side at the last close)
base_mandatory_exit_time: LBR exit decision bar close (activation + 2 bars), C max_hold expiry; G3 and B3/K04 -1; never the realized exit
C decision_time = available_time = fill minute T (R2-37 zero-latency contract): observations at T must exclude the minute-T market row
native pending: C has none (fill at the decision minute open); B3/K04 pending = decision minute while flat (market order executes at the next open)
